title: Blackstone Sesame-Pineapple Chicken
description: Chicken steams in pineapple and ginger under a griddle dome before its juices become a glossy sesame glaze.
equipment: Small rimmed stainless steel tray that fits beneath the basting dome
Immersion blender and deep heatproof jug

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken thighs
ingredients.note: Use plain, unenhanced poultry. Remove visible fat before weighing.

ingredients.name: crushed pineapple in pineapple juice
ingredients.note: Unsweetened. Measure the fruit and its juice together.

ingredients.name: low-sodium chicken broth
ingredients.note: Use plain chicken-and-water broth without a vegetable blend or added seasoning.

steps.title: Warm the tray
steps.text: Set one Blackstone burner to medium-low and preheat for 5 minutes. Place a shallow rimmed stainless steel tray over the burner, pour in the pineapple liquid and cover with the basting dome until the liquid gently simmers.

steps.title: Steam the thighs
steps.text: Cut {chicken} across the grain into short strips about 1/2 inch thick. Lay them in one layer in the simmering liquid and cover the tray with the dome.

steps.title: Check the centers
steps.text: Maintain a gentle simmer for 8–14 minutes, turning the pieces once with tongs. Transfer each piece to a covered bowl with a spoonful of liquid when its thickest center reaches 175°F.

steps.title: Boil the cooking liquid
steps.text: Use heatproof mitts to pour the tray liquid into the HexClad. Bring to a full boil on the stovetop and stir for 1 minute.

steps.title: Bind the sauce
steps.text: Bring the sauce to a simmer. Whisk in the freshly stirred slurry and let it bubble gently for 1 minute, stirring until it coats the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Finish with sesame
steps.text: Whisk {sesame} into the hot glaze off heat.

steps.title: Sauce and serve
steps.text: Fold the chicken and its juices into the glaze and spoon into bowls, dividing the glaze evenly.

notes: Sauce yield: About 1 1/4 cups for two. Make ahead: Blend the pineapple base up to 1 day ahead and refrigerate it separately from the chicken. Refrigerate shallow portions within 2 hours, or within 1 hour outdoors above 90°F. Use refrigerated leftovers within 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze the chicken submerged in its glaze for up to 2 months. Stir gently as it warms. Fridge reheat: Warm the glazed chicken covered in the HexClad over medium-low with a splash of water. Stir or turn occasionally and check from 6 minutes, until the center reaches 165°F. Freezer reheat: Thaw overnight in the refrigerator, then follow the fridge reheating directions. Option A uses pineapple and ginger. For gentler Option B, replace the pineapple with the same volume of peeled ripe pear puree and omit the ginger. The glaze is dairy-free. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 253 kcal, 29.1 g protein, 14.9 g total carbohydrate, 8.2 g fat, 0.6 g fiber, 241 mg sodium. Includes all the chicken and sauce in the listed recipe. Sodium varies with the broth.
